paras: Treutler's gecko (Hemidactylus treutleri) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to India.
The specific name, treutleri, is in honor of German-born Irish herpetoculturist Uli Treutler (1951–2006).
H. treutleri is found in the southern Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
The preferred natural habitats of H. treutleri are forest and shrubland, at altitudes of 350–720 m (1,150–2,360 ft).
